_comment: The KepSim six-station line (labs/kepsim) served in the twin's OWN address space by `mes run-opc-sim --replay`. Objects and tag names match the CSV tables exactly, so the same data reads identically here and through Kepware — only the addressing differs (see tag_map_kepware.json). Every machine is read-only: `order_tag` is null because a CSV replay cannot be written to. Orders still flow, because OPC counter deltas auto-start a released operation.
_state_map: The line's State column is a PLC-style integer. Mapping it is a site decision with real consequences: starved and blocked are IDLE (the machine is healthy, it just has nothing to do), changeover is SETUP (a planned stop, which must not count against availability), and only a genuine fault is DOWN.
_tags: Each machine subscribes to everything its line publishes: the loader fills that in from the generated tags.json. Set extra_tags on a machine only to pin a hand-picked subset, which is what a real server needs.
